newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's MRCB in Croatian bank venture.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's MRCB in Croatian bank venture.

text.p: Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) said it has entered into an agreement with Croatian firm Niva Inc to set up a joint venture bank in Croatia.

In a statement released late on Wednesday, MRCB said it and Niva, an investment holding firm, would participate in the venture on a 50-50 basis. Niva's founder is Nikica Valentic, the former prime minister of Croatia.
The bank's initial paid-up capital is 16 million ringgit, which will rise to 24 million ringgit within one year of the start of operations. The bank is expected to begin operations before year end.

MRCB's portion of the capital will be sourced from internal funds. Under the agreement with Niva, the Croatian company will nominate the bank's president, while MRCB will nominate the vice president who will be a Malaysian.
MRCB, a diversified concern whose interests include media and construction, said the joint venture is its strategic first step into Eastern and Central Europe.
